author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: A.J. Puk (shoulder) shut down for four weeks
desc: A.J. Puk recently underwent an MRI that revealed a left shoulder capsule sprain, and he has been shut down for four weeks.
impact: Puk underwent an internal brace procedure in June 2025 with hopes of returning in the middle of this season. However, he suffered a setback following his second rehab outing with Triple-A Reno and has been shut down from throwing for four weeks. He does not currently have a timetable for his return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Isiah Kiner-Falefa (forearm) to undergo MRI
desc: Isiah Kiner-Falefa was scratched from Friday's contest against the Seattle Mariners due to left forearm inflammation and is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Saturday.
impact: Kiner-Falefa was scratched just 30 minutes before first pitch. He said after the game that he has been dealing with pain and inflammation in his left forearm for the past two weeks, with the discomfort recently worsening. It should become clearer whether he'll require a stint on the injured list once the Boston Red Sox receive his MRI results.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Tanner Gordon (hip) to face hitters Saturday
desc: Tanner Gordon is scheduled to throw a live batting practice session on Saturday.
impact: Gordon has been sidelined since June 5 due to a right hip impingement. He is scheduled to face hitters at Coors Field on Saturday, and if all goes well, he could begin a minor league rehab assignment next week.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Brenton Doyle (oblique) expected to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Brenton Doyle is expected to begin a minor league rehab assignment on Tuesday.
impact: Doyle is inching closer to game action as he continues to participate in baseball activities. He has been sidelined since May 21 due to a left oblique contusion, but could return to the Colorado Rockies lineup in late June.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jonathan Aranda launches homer Friday
desc: Jonathan Aranda went 1-for-4 with a home run, one run scored and three RBI in Friday's 5-2 win over the Washington Nationals.
impact: Aranda hit a three-run home run off Miles Mikolas in the third inning for his first homer of the month. After an impressive May in which he slashed .374/.464/.560, he has cooled off in June, posting a .224/.318/.293 slash line. He has recorded a hit in two straight games and will look to get back on track in the weekend series against the Nationals.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jonny DeLuca goes yard Friday
desc: Jonny DeLuca went 1-for-4 with a solo home run in Friday's 5-2 win over the Washington Nationals.
impact: DeLuca was activated from the injured list on Friday and wasted little time making an impact, launching a 398-foot home run off Miles Mikolas in the eighth inning for his third homer of the season. He now owns a .268 batting average and .728 OPS across 123 at-bats and could see consistent playing time with Jake Fraley (hernia) sidelined.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Bryan Baker picks up save Friday
desc: Bryan Baker allowed no hits or walks while striking out one batter in a scoreless ninth inning on Friday to earn his 19th save of the season in a 5-2 win over the Washington Nationals.
impact: Baker has not allowed an earned run in 11 consecutive appearances and has converted eight saves during that stretch. The right-hander owns an impressive 1.84 ERA and 0.92 WHIP on the season and is tied for second among all relievers with 19 saves.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Griffin Jax picks up win Friday
desc: Griffin Jax allowed two runs on four hits and no walks while striking out five over five innings in Friday's 5-2 win over the Washington Nationals.
impact: Jax allowed just four hits on Friday, but two of them left the yard for solo home runs. Despite the long balls, he turned in another strong outing and earned his second win of the season. Through 10 starts, he owns an impressive 2.70 ERA and 1.18 WHIP with 36 strikeouts across 40 innings. His next scheduled start is on Wednesday against the Kansas City Royals.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Otto Lopez steals base Friday
desc: Otto Lopez went 1-for-4 with a stolen base in Friday's 4-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Lopez has now reached base safely in 12 consecutive games and continues to swing a productive bat, posting a .348/.389/.500 slash line in June. He also remains the league leader in batting average, hitting .334 on the season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Esteury Ruiz logs stolen base Friday
desc: Esteury Ruiz was hit by a pitch, drew a walk, scored a run and stole a base in Friday's 4-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Ruiz entered the game as a pinch hitter for Joe Mack in the seventh inning and was hit by a pitch in his first plate appearance. He later drew a walk in the eighth inning, stole second base and came around to score. Despite logging just 68 at-bats this season, Ruiz owns an impressive .937 OPS to go along with 13 stolen bases.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jakob Marsee swipes bag Friday
desc: Jakob Marsee went 1-for-3 with a walk and a stolen base in Friday's 4-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Marsee is riding a four-game hitting streak and has contributed a home run and a stolen base during that stretch. While he's batting just .203 on the season, his speed has helped offset the low average, as his 18 stolen bases are tied for third-most among outfielders.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Owen Caissie goes deep Friday
desc: Owen Caissie went 3-for-3 with one home run, a double, one run scored and three RBI in Friday's 4-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Caissie entered Friday's game mired in a 3-for-33 slump in June, but he homered for the second consecutive game and has now gone 4-for-8 with three extra-base hits and four RBI over his last two contests. While it's still a small sample, this could be the beginning of a turnaround at the plate.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Pete Fairbanks picks up save Friday
desc: Pete Fairbanks pitched a 1-2-3 ninth inning in Friday's 4-3 win over the San Francisco Giants to pick up his 10th save of the season.
impact: While Fairbanks didn't record a strikeout, he secured the save on just 17 pitches. He has posted scoreless outings in three of his last four appearances and owns a 4.05 ERA with four saves in June. Despite some inconsistency this season, Fairbanks remains the Miami Marlins' primary option in the ninth inning.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ty France blasts two home runs Friday
desc: Ty France went 3-for-4 with two home runs and five RBI in the Padres 9-7 loss against the Rangers on Friday.
impact: France capped off a five-run opening frame with a grand slam off Jacob deGrom. He later added another solo blast off deGrom in the fourth inning. It turned out to be one of the best performances of his career.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gavin Sheets goes yard Friday
desc: Gavin Sheets went 2-for-4 with a home run in the Padres 9-7 loss on Friday against the Rangers.
impact: Sheets got the scoring going with an RBI single as part of a five-run first inning for the Padres. He later cut the deficit to 8-7 with a solo blast to open the eighth inning.
